decisions.subject: Pipeline for a two-character nursery rhyme

options_considered.label: character-animation
options_considered.reason: Purpose-built for local rigged cartoon characters with dialogue between 1-2 characters - exact match for Johny + Papa

options_considered.label: animation
options_considered.reason: Production-stable but designed for motion graphics/diagrams, not character acting; would route dialogue scenes awkwardly

options_considered.label: cinematic
options_considered.reason: Mood-led edits of generated footage; no character acting

decisions.reason: The rhyme is a two-character call-and-response; character-animation is the only pipeline with character_design, rig_plan, and action_timeline stages. Marked beta - disclosed to user.

decisions.subject: Composition runtime for character acting

options_considered.label: hyperframes
options_considered.reason: character_rig_renderer natively emits a HyperFrames workspace + GSAP composition; HTML/SVG/GSAP is the natural medium for rigged SVG characters; lint+validate available

options_considered.label: remotion
options_considered.reason: Available and strong for caption burn, but the character rig renderer's native handoff is HyperFrames; word-level karaoke (not needed here) is the main Remotion advantage
options_considered.rejected_because: renderer handoff is HyperFrames-native; no karaoke requirement in selected concept c1

options_considered.label: ffmpeg
options_considered.reason: Post-processing only

decisions.reason: Both remotion and hyperframes were available and both presented (hard rule). HyperFrames selected because the pipeline's own character_rig_renderer emits a HyperFrames workspace, and concept c1 does not require Remotion-only features (no word-level karaoke, no TalkingHead). Motion_required=true: this runtime is a commitment, not a hint.

decisions.subject: How the composition is built

options_considered.label: atelier
options_considered.reason: Hand-author a project-local composition: custom kitchen scene, custom characters, custom captions - no stock scene components fit a nursery rhyme

options_considered.label: templated
options_considered.reason: Stock cut.type scenes (text_card, stat_card) do not match this content

decisions.reason: Hero character work; art direction committed in production_plan.art_direction.

decisions.subject: Visual style playbook

options_considered.label: flat-motion-graphics
options_considered.reason: Recommended by the pipeline manifest for this pipeline; bright rounded flat style is the canonical children's-content look and maximizes caption legibility

options_considered.label: anime-ghibli
options_considered.reason: Also listed as compatible, but painterly style is far harder to author as local SVG rigs
options_considered.rejected_because: style cannot be faithfully realized with local SVG rigging

options_considered.label: ink-sketch (Ink Theater)
options_considered.reason: Charming doodle look with mocap, but the user asked for the classic cartoon nursery-rhyme feel, and Ink Puppet's mocap catalog (walk/dance/kick) does not cover tiptoe/eat/peek acting

decisions.reason: Best match to target audience and to what local SVG rigging can actually produce well.

decisions.subject: TTS provider for the two voices

options_considered.label: piper (local)
options_considered.reason: The only TTS available in this sandbox (0 cloud API keys configured). Two distinct voices downloaded and tested: en_US-lessac-medium (Johny), en_GB-alan-medium (Papa). Free, offline, deterministic.

options_considered.label: elevenlabs (cloud)
options_considered.reason: Expressive voices, but requires ELEVENLABS_API_KEY which is not configured
options_considered.rejected_because: no API key in this environment

options_considered.label: openai_tts (cloud)
options_considered.reason: Good quality but requires OPENAI_API_KEY
options_considered.rejected_because: no API key in this environment

decisions.reason: Only available option; sample-first rule applies - 2 sample lines per character presented before batch generation.

decisions.subject: Music bed for the rhyme

options_considered.label: local FFmpeg lullaby synth
options_considered.reason: Free, offline, deterministic: gentle chord arpeggio with soft dynamics, ~70s, loopable. Simple but warm.

options_considered.label: pixabay_music (stock search)
options_considered.reason: Free stock lullabies exist, but the tool returned HTTP 403 from this sandbox (datacenter IP block) on two attempts

options_considered.label: suno/elevenlabs music gen
options_considered.reason: Composed lullaby, but requires API keys
options_considered.rejected_because: no API keys in this environment

decisions.reason: Only working music path. Music sits low under dialogue (ducked), so the simplicity is acceptable. User may opt out to silence at the gate.

decisions.subject: Selected concept

options_considered.label: The Pantry Door
options_considered.reason: 2-character sweet spot, one coherent scene system, bright legible palette

options_considered.label: Karaoke Kitchen
options_considered.reason: Strong short-form hook but needs Remotion-only karaoke captions and a beat-driven music bed that is hard to synthesize

options_considered.label: Bedtime Johny
options_considered.reason: Mood variant of c1; darker palette hurts pre-reader legibility

decisions.reason: Agent recommendation; user approval pending at this gate.
